report.scope: Full original transient and unchanged sampler/device gates. History groups exclude edge bits and are diagnostic only. No claimed measured internal clock timing, closed-loop CDR, PHY acceptance or manufacturing qualification.

internal_clock_pairs.scope: All positive/negative clock branch combinations within each shared-emitter bank, including parallel devices. No arbitrary one-to-one physical pairing. Bases connected to cp/cn through numeric wire R. Group labels bound through actual MOS drain connectivity. No clock alignment edits, timing waiver, output sampling pass or PLL recovery claim.

physical_clock_observation.scope: Receiver cp/cn physical port voltages only; not recovered-clock closed-loop proof

sampler_c_backtrace.scope: Connectivity backtrace includes feedback and clock devices; does not assert forward gain. Raw differential voltage, not polarity-adjusted margin. Same frozen rising-edge phases 0.3/0.6/0.9 UI, grouped by bit history; no sample realignment or acceptance edits.

phase_resolved_sampler_c.scope: Diagnostic exact source-clock phases. Simultaneous differential voltages/currents computed before aggregation. Device labels are topology roles to inspect, not independent proof of gain. Original gates reproduced unchanged; no candidate acceptance.
